# while

Repeat an indented block while a condition is true.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `block.while` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Blocks |
| Family | Iteration |
| Monaco kind | `block` |
| Format | `while <condition>:` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `while condition:<br>    -- body<br>` |

## Example

```lua
while condition:
    -- body
```
